name: Sierra Components Inc
old_description: Sierra Components adds Component Design, Packaging and more to our list of services.
about:
Sierra Components Inc. was founded in 1992 in Minden, Nevada, as a family-run business serving the microelectronics industry. What began with a fax machine, a flow hood, and a few nitrogen boxes has grown into a multi-million-dollar distribution and processing facility specializing in silicon wafers and bare die. The company's president and founder brings over 40 years of bare-die distribution experience and more than 42 years in the microelectronics field.

Today the firm operates as a distribution and processing center, offering visual inspection to MIL-STD-883 Method 2010 and MIL-STD-750 Methods 2072/2073, element evaluation and lot qualification to MIL-PRF-38534D Levels H and K, MIL-PRF-19500, and customer source-control drawings. It also provides alternate-component sourcing, wafer processing such as SAW sort and inspection of wafers to die form and wafer probe, and a surplus-inventory program that stores and sells excess stock with a guaranteed return of at least 50 percent of book value. A partnership with Kooker Technologies adds component design, packaging, and substrate fabrication with fast turnaround times.

Sierra Components serves the microelectronics and semiconductor sectors, including customers who require military-grade qualification to MIL-PRF-38534D and MIL-PRF-19500. Its client base includes original equipment manufacturers and other buyers needing bare-die distribution, wafer-level processing, and obsolescence management.

The founder's stated goal has been to provide top-notch service with a personal touch—no automated attendants, just a real person on the phone. The company describes itself as large enough to handle the task yet small enough to give each customer individual attention, a philosophy reinforced by a staff with over 78 combined years in the semiconductor industry.
